name: perl-mojolicious-api
title: Perl Mojolicious API
blurb: Mojolicious JSON service on Perl 5: a pure route table, a Test::More suite, and a JSON 404 that never leaks a template error

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
set -e
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5426/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5426 is already answering - stop that process before running this step'; exit 1; fi
PORT=5426 perl bin/{{ npm_name }} > .mojo.log 2>&1 &
server=$!
trap 'kill -TERM -"$server" 2>/dev/null || kill $server 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
kill -0 $server 2>/dev/null || { cat .mojo.log; echo 'the service exited before it answered'; exit 1; }
ok=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5426/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ $ok -ne 1 ]; then echo 'the service never answered'; cat .mojo.log; kill $server 2>/dev/null || true; exit 1; fi
health=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:5426/health)
test "$health" = '{"status":"ok"}'
get=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 'http://127.0.0.1:5426/stats?text=hello%20world%0A')
printf '%s' "$get" | grep -q '"lines":1'
printf '%s' "$get" | grep -q '"bytes":12'
posted=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b\nc\n"}' http://127.0.0.1:5426/stats)
printf '%s' "$posted" | grep -q '"words":3'
missing=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5426/stats)
test "$missing" = 422
broken=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary 'nope' http://127.0.0.1:5426/stats)
printf '%s' "$broken" | grep -q 'invalid_json'
gone=$(curl -sS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5426/nope)
test "$gone" = 404
kill $server 2>/dev/null || true
wait $server 2>/dev/null || true
